If you are already proficient with the relevant skills and if you looking to gain some work experience by working on a project guided by an experienced developer, then this program is for you!

You will build software solutions using all the skills that you honed in any track and gain valuable work experience with a mentor/senior helping you throughout. You follow Agile methodologies and complete your stories and tasks taking help from seniors as required.

Eligibility

Any student proficient in HTML/CSS and JavaScript can apply for Front End Developer Apprenticeship

Any student proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Java and Advanced Java can apply for the Full Stack Developer Apprenticeship project

Any student proficient in Java and Advanced Java can apply for Backend Developer Apprenticeship

Any student proficient in Python, Data Analytics, Data Science, and Big Data, can apply for Data Scientist/Engineer Apprenticeship

 

If you completed the required prerequisite through us, you are eligible to apply.

If self-taught the relevant technologies through Udemy, or other MOCC institutions, no problem!  We love self-taught students! Take a test out from us to be eligible to enroll!

Deadline to apply for NCWIT Scholarship: 4 weeks before the start date
